group.name: backup_plugin
group.title: Backup Plugin Settings
group.description: Control how the Backup Plugin scans and packs plugin files.

settings.name: scan_mode
settings.title: Scan Mode
settings.description: Balanced: every file owned by the plugin folder is included, plus name-matched files whose content really references the plugin. Strict: only the plugin folder plus files that plugin code actually loads (require/include) are included.

settings.name: excluded_paths
settings.title: Excluded Paths
settings.description: One path per line, relative to the forum root. A folder entry excludes the whole tree. Wildcards are allowed (for example *.log or inc/plugins/*/backups). Exclusions always win over everything else.
settings.value:
inc/plugins/temp
Backup Plugins
admin/backups
uploads
.git
node_modules

settings.name: included_paths
settings.title: Extra Paths To Include
settings.description: One path per line, relative to the forum root. These folders or files are always treated as part of the plugin even when they live outside the plugin folder. Use it when a plugin keeps assets or admin pages somewhere else.

settings.name: include_pluginlibrary
settings.title: Back Up PluginLibrary
settings.description: When the plugin being backed up uses the PluginLibrary plugin, add inc/plugins/pluginlibrary.php to the package. Turn this off to ship the plugin without the shared library.

settings.name: include_root_scripts
settings.title: Back Up Root Scripts
settings.description: Include entry scripts placed in the forum root (for example sw.js or store.php) when they really belong to the plugin. A file must reference the plugin folder or use the plugin prefix.

settings.name: include_external_dependencies
settings.title: Back Up Other Plugins
settings.description: Include files from other plugins that the plugin hard loads with require/include. Leave this off to keep every package limited to one plugin.

settings.name: max_file_size
settings.title: Maximum File Size (KB)
settings.description: Skip any single file larger than this size in kilobytes. Set to 0 to allow every file.

settings.name: show_skipped
settings.title: Show Skipped Files
settings.description: List the files that were left out of the package on the scan page, together with the reason each one was skipped.
